text:
emily: Quick prelaunch ask — can runtime run a short stability probe for the launch bench claims? Need cold-first-token and cache-miss tails for the quantized demo model. Prefer dedicated slot.
tyler_runtime: sure. point me at payload + model pin and well schedule. how long do you want the sweep?
emily: payload in s3://marketing-artifacts/launch/smoke-v1.json (30 prompts: mix short/long + 5 adversarial). model pin: `redwood-demo-q4_0`. Target ~8m total.
tyler_runtime: ok. we'll run three variants: cache_on, cache_off, cache_off_with_cpu_fallback. collect p50/p90/p99 and first_token_cold. save raw responses for up to 2 fails.
sam_ops: I can reserve a 10m slot on analytics-dedicated at 10:20 PT, pre-warm it.
bench-bot: Job 77788 queued on analytics-dedicated. Tag: marketing/launch/smoke-v1 :hourglass:
tyler_runtime: run finished. Uploading metrics to s3://redwood-results/marketing/launch/1819990000/metrics.json. Quick summary: cache_off p99 ~880ms (one long adversarial), 1 OOM->cpu_fallback in variant cache_off_with_cpu_fallback (prompt_idx 14). Saved 2 raw captures.
emily: paste the manifest line for the OOM event here?
tyler_runtime: {"prompt_idx":14,"variant":"cache_off_with_cpu_fallback","event":"oom","fallback":"cpu_gen_q2"}
emily: tagging @ana_sales for lead routing if EU p99 > 600ms. Ana, please attach metrics to the inbound ticket if needed.
anana_sales: on it. I'll flag any EU leads and include the s3 link.
sam_ops: cleaning reserved slot. artifacts retained for 7 days.
emily: thanks all  we'll include a slide note: "dedicated pre-warmed slot; warmup=60; seed=2026; dedicated pool; shared may vary."
